units.source_text: 我手里拎着的鼓鼓的纸口袋与我的关系，就如同我此刻即将着手干的完全孤立的行为与这种寒碜的夹馅面包的关系……

en.t: The relation between me and the bulging paper bag I was carrying in my hand was like the relation between the utterly isolated act I was about to undertake and this shabby stuffed bun...

units.source_text: 从阴沉沉的上空透出的阳光，恍如闷热的雾零，笼罩着屋宇柿比的老市街。

en.t: The sunlight filtering through the gloomy sky hung over the old city streets, where the houses stood crowded together, like a sweltering mist.

units.source_text: 汗珠突然悄悄地在我脊背上划了几道冷线流淌了下来。

en.t: Suddenly, beads of sweat silently traced several cold lines down my back.
